units.source_text: 她十五六岁上，在正月和夏季的两个月旅馆缺女佣的时候，就去帮忙。

en.t: When she was fifteen or sixteen, she would go to help out during the New Year season and the two summer months, when the inn was short of maids.

units.source_text: 她在澡塘里赤着身子的时候，泡在温泉里的男客们的话声就戛然而止。

en.t: When she was naked in the bathhouse, the voices of the male guests soaking in the hot spring would suddenly fall silent.

units.source_text: 她那健美的手脚，看上去像个妙龄的姑娘。

en.t: Her strong, beautiful arms and legs made her look like a young woman in the bloom of youth.
She was like a piece of white iron.
